A '''monastery''' of the [[Baran Do]], an order of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] sages comprised of members of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was used by a secret [[Darth Sion cult|cult]] within the Baran Do that worshipped the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sion]]<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" /> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> In the temple, which by that [[Time/Legends|time]] was ancient, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult placed offerings to the long-[[Death/Legends|deceased]] Sith Lord.<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to seek information on the cult after uncovering evidence of its existence. The companion discovered the monastery and retrieved the offerings the cultists had left there for Darth Sion.<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The monastery was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Corruption of the Baran Do" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the video game.<ref name="Corruption of the Baran Do" />
